risks.risk: Console variant/region not confirmed (PS5 Slim vs Fat, and region), which affects value and compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console model/serial label (sticker) showing the exact model number (e.g., CFI-xxxx) and region.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case comparable among PS5 listings (treat as generic/unknown PS5 condition and variant).

risks.risk: No proof the console works (disc drive, HDMI output, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth, controller pairing).
risks.proof: A short video showing the console powering on to the home screen and the controller pairing; ideally also a disc test if a FIFA disc is included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/assume basic functionality not guaranteed (worst-case within PS5 comparables).

risks.risk: FIFA disc may be missing or not included as claimed.
risks.proof: Photo of the FIFA disc and/or the disc case showing the title, plus a photo of everything included laid out together.

risks.risk: Accessories completeness not confirmed (exact cables, headset, extra controller, etc.).
risks.proof: A full “included items” photo showing every accessory one by one (power cable, HDMI, controller charging cable, etc.).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the visible essentials are included.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the console sticker/model number (CFI-xxxx) and serial label (photo of the bottom/back label).
Video proof: power on to home screen + controller connected/working.
Photo of the FIFA disc (title visible) and a photo of all included items laid out together.
response.reason: The photos confirm a PS5-looking console and controller, but the key details that set the price (exact PS5 model/region and working/disc-drive proof, plus whether FIFA disc is actually included) are not verifiable from the provided images.
